children: Overview
US regional bank's Q3 net income and EPS were flat year-over-year
Net interest income for Q3 rose 4.8% year-over-year
Company repurchased 185,833 shares during the quarter
Outlook
Company says net charge-off ratio remains within full-year guidance
Company remains focused on credit-disciplined loan growth in Upstate New York
Company says strong capital levels support loan growth and investments
Result Drivers
COMMERCIAL LENDING - Co said loan growth was driven by strong commercial lending activity in Western and Central New York markets
NET INTEREST MARGIN - Net interest margin rose due to lower interest-bearing liability costs, supporting higher net interest income
INVESTMENT ADVISORY - Growth in investment advisory income reflected new business and market performance
